issue_context.title: Azure stack support for azure cloud provider lib
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
PR(https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/azuredisk-csi-driver/pull/445) already proves that old api-version on Azure stack works on global Azure too, we could support azure stack in azure cloud provider lib, and then make sure following components works in Azure stack:
 - CSI drivers: azure disk, azure file
 - CCM

Since it's mainly api-version change, we could also add e2e tests against global Azure too.

**Why is this needed**:

/assign
/priority important-soon
/sig cloud-provider
/area provider/azure
